line: Welcome. The booth is always on camera. You are safe in here.
Do the whole round. Checkpoints first. Then the generator.
If the floor isn't glowing you shouldn't be standing on it.
The lights go funny around two. Watch which red lights stay on.
Cam 14 turns by itself. Don't report it.
Power cut at 3:10 last night. I made it under cam 3.
The corridor is the worst place to be when it goes dark.
Somebody is cutting the lines. Not me.
Splice them fast. A dead camera is a hole in the floor.
If you read this finish the round and leave.
Don't go down to P4. Whatever they tell you.
